caption: The worked example as one chain: the 127-byte PSDU plus the 6 bytes the PHY adds gives 133 bytes on air, which is 1064 bits and takes 4.256 ms at 250 kbps.

spec.title: On-air time of a 127-byte PSDU at 250 kbps
spec.aria: A flow from a 127-byte PSDU and the 6 bytes of PHY overhead (4-byte preamble, 1-byte SFD, 1-byte length) to 133 bytes on air, then 133 times 8 equals 1064 bits, then 1064 divided by 250000 bits per second equals 4.256 milliseconds.
